releaseNotes: FIXED — THE ACCOUNT SWITCHER IS REBUILT: the floating bubble and its button are GONE (that button was crashing the clone on open). Now it works the way Discord itself does — HOLD the app's own profile tab (bottom-right corner) and the Ophelia accounts drawer slides up: your logged-in account, one-tap switch, and an Add-account button that saves this login and restarts logged out for the next one. No logout, ever.

FIXED — CUSTOM APP LOGOS: whatever picture you pick, of ANY width or shape, is now fitted whole into the launcher's visible circle — the entire logo is shown, edge to edge, with zero blank space and no more cut-off wordmarks. Works in both the clone wizard and Edit clone.

REMOVED — the delete/uninstall button on clone cards. Uninstall a clone the normal Android way: hold its icon on the home screen/app drawer → Uninstall. Stale entries clean themselves up automatically.

Under the hood: the switcher now lives 100% inside the app's own window and main process (no more injected panel activity or secondary process) — the smallest possible footprint, and one less thing exotic ROMs can crash on.
